pattern: HTML <article> named by its heading; interactive cards use the block-link pattern (Inclusive Components 'Cards'): one real link on the title, stretched over the card with a pseudo-element.

keyboard.action: One tab stop: the title link. Other controls inside the card (for example footer buttons) are separate tab stops after it.
The card itself is not focusable; focus moves through any controls in its content.

focus: Interactive cards draw the focus indicator on the whole card (:has(.aui-card__link:focus-visible)) and underline the title; the link's own outline is suppressed so only one indicator shows.
notes: Screen readers announce only the title as the link name, not the whole card content.
The media area is visually first but after the header in source order, so the heading is reached first when navigating by heading or reading.
Section containers are <div>s, not <header>/<footer>, so untitled cards never create banner or contentinfo landmarks.
Consumers must give informative images in media a text alternative, or alt="" when decorative.
knownCaveats: Mouse text selection inside interactive cards is limited by the link overlay.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
